mentions.name: Orris
mentions.description: Orris is a breathing app for iOS offering guided breathing sessions with variable phase durations (e.g., 4-7-8 and box breathing), streak tracking, and HealthKit integration. It is built with SwiftUI and Swift 6 with no backend, and ambient soundscapes for sleep sessions are being explored next.
mentions.problem: The author wanted something simple for winding down before sleep, but existing breathing apps were bloated with unwanted content or locked basic features behind a paywall.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on building Orris (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/orris-breathing-exercises/id6749783699): a breathing app for iOS.
